_comment: THE PUBLISH MANIFEST. The installer itself cannot live in this repository — it is 91,807,232
bytes and writehuman-v2/agent/dist/ is gitignored — so this file is what the publish workflow
enforces: the bytes it is handed must match this version, size and digest exactly, or nothing
is promoted. It is not a description of what is published; it is the gate on what may be.
Measured locally with `node backend/scripts/release-gate.cjs` (5/5): the EXE's embedded agent
source is byte-identical to writehuman-v2/agent/cookie-sync-agent.js in this tree, whose
AGENT_VERSION is 3.5.15, and the PE header checksum matches the bytes.
builtAt is null on purpose. The only timestamp available is the ZIP member mtime of the EXE
(2026-10-17T14:26:00Z), which records when the archive was written, not when the binary was
built, and an archive time presented as a build time is a fabrication.
